entry.name: bangbang
entry.digest: Output a bang from many outlets
entry.description: Outputs bang messages out of each outlet (in right-to-left order) when it receives any input. The number of outlets is determined by an argument.

arguments.name: outlets
arguments.description: Sets the number of outlets. The number of outlets can be any number between 1 and 40. Floats are converted to ints.
